claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_class_feature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The first bullet of Disciplined Survivor is a permanent passive grant (proficiency in all saving throws). It has no activation cost, no use count, and no reset cadence. The existing ClassFeatureMechanics only has `activation` family, which mandates activationCost + resource + resetCadence. A passive always-on feature cannot be represented in the activation family without lying about those fields.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your physical and mental discipline grant you proficiency in all saving throws.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_proficiency (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive saving throw proficiency grant requires a `grant_proficiency` effect. ClassFeatureEffect is currently limited to `grant_extra_action | heal_hp`. The v4 taxonomy includes `grant_proficiency` as an effect atom (§9), but it is not in the surface type's ClassFeatureEffect union.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your physical and mental discipline grant you proficiency in all saving throws.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: triggered_optional_class_feature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reroll mechanic is a trigger-gated optional ability: it fires on a specific event (failed saving throw = post_roll_window on failure), the player chooses whether to invoke it (optional), and it consumes a Focus Point. This is not a player-initiated `activation` — the trigger window opens externally, not from a player decision to use the feature. No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family covers this shape. The closest analog in the spell surface is `triggered_reaction`, but there is no class-feature equivalent.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can expend 1 Focus Point to reroll it, and you must use the new roll.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: focus_point (ClassFeatureActivationCost variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reroll costs 1 Focus Point — a monk-specific resource distinct from action economy (not `free`, not `bonus_action`). ClassFeatureActivationCost has no cost variant for expending a class-specific point resource. This is the same pattern as Stunning Strike, Patient Defense, etc. A `focus_point` (or generic `class_point`) cost variant is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 1 Focus Point to reroll it

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_reroll (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reroll effect is `modify_roll_reroll` from v4 taxonomy §9, but this atom is not represented in ClassFeatureEffect (only `grant_extra_action | heal_hp`). The effect forces a reroll of a specific roll already made, with the constraint `must use new roll`.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 1 Focus Point to reroll it, and you must use the new roll.
